title: OpenCastle team config
description: A layer's config: .opencastle/config.json in a project, or config.json at the root of a baseline's layer. Later layers add to and override earlier ones; policy can only be tightened.

itemRef.description: A kind and a name, e.g. "skills/seo-patterns" or "agents/content-engineer".

opencastle.description: The OpenCastle versions this project or baseline works with, as a semver range (e.g. "^0.36.0"). Commands refuse to compile with any other.

extends.description: Baselines to build on: package names (installed as devDependencies; the lockfile pins the version) or paths starting with ./ or ../, relative to this file.

exclude.description: Items from the layers below to leave out, e.g. "skills/seo-patterns", or an MCP server they define or an integration brings, e.g. "mcpServers/Slack".

mcpServers.description: MCP servers every assistant gets. Write variables as ${NAME}; each assistant receives its own spelling. Sync writes these exactly as defined.

type.description: Inferred from command or url when omitted.

env.description: Environment for a local server, e.g. { "API_URL": "${API_URL}" }.

headers.description: Headers for a remote server, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}" }.

policy.description: Rules every repository extending this layer is held to, by sync, doctor and sync --check. A layer above can tighten them, never relax them.

allow.description: MCP server names an assistant may start; * matches any run of characters. Integration servers not on it are left out; any other server in a config fails the check.

remoteHosts.description: Hosts remote servers may connect to; *.example.com matches its subdomains.

requirePinned.description: Every server launched through a package runner must name an exact version, or run the project's own copy (npx --no).

require.description: Items no layer above may exclude or replace.

contextBudget.description: Tokens every assistant may load before it reads the task: always-loaded instructions plus the skill and agent index. doctor warns above it.
